    Γ is bijective on the morphisms computing extensions in C_J #

    For objects C, A of C_J, the shadow functor Γ : K(Q) ⥤ D(Rep k I) is bijective on K(Q)(F C, (F A)⟦1⟧). By additivity it suffices to treat indecomposables. Morphisms out of L[-1] into (F A)⟦1⟧, and from the resolution of an interval into L[-1]⟦1⟧ = L, vanish for degree reasons or because Q(interval, L) = 0; on both sides of Γ these sets are zero. Between resolutions of intervals, Γ restricts to G, which is bijective since the shifted resolutions are K-injective.
